cZw.text: This is the main script for movement. You don't need to change anything here if you're adding a character.

cZy.text: This is part of the main platforming script, and is just here to stop that weird bumping when you land in most platformers.

cZA.text: This code is everywhere, and all it does is makes it so everything moves with the camera.

cZC.text:
This script sets the stats to different numbers depending on who you're playing as.

speed is how fast you move. (on average about 1)

slipperyness is how slippery the character is, make sure to increase speed if you turn the slipperyness down (0.5 means you will stop as soon as you let go of a key, 0.99 would mean you slide for ages)

weight is how fast you fall (on average about 1)

jump is how high you jump, make sure to increase this if the weight is high (on average about 15)

defense isn't anything to do with health, but just how far you get flung after each hit. (on average about 1)

cZE.text:
This is for attacks. The way the anim variable works is when it is set to, for example, "fly", then if your current character has a costume with "fly" at the end, it will switch to that costume.
Some animations are detected by the attack sprite and activates an attack (for example, FunnyAnimatorJimTV has his

cZG.text: This is for specials, which is mostly the same apart from the ultimates which are

cZK.text: This script sets the Hp when you start. On average, Hp is about 20.

cZM.text: This script is for getting hit by an attack.

cZO.text: This code just makes sure that the ultimate meter doesn't go past the limit.

cZQ.text: This is just here to make it so you can't get hurt during an ultimate and that two ultimates can't happen at the same time.

cZT.text:
PATCH 1.2 - Svet Update (working name)

General Changes
-Added Dodges, which are inputted by using B/H.
-Added additional keybinds for P1 meant to make singleplayer gameplay easier
-Added more hit sound effects
-Made assists have variable costs to summon them
-Optimized puppet code

RAE
-DM now instakills

TEM
-Reduced HP from 41 to 40

PENCILINE
-Increased starting lag of AN

MUSHBY
-Increased damage of RN, DN, and AN

HEKTOR
-Increased knockback of AN and adjusted angle

HEKTOR & FANCY
-Increased damage and stuntime of puppets

CANVAS
-Slightly reduced damage of RN
-Added more lag to the end of Explosives (DM31#3)

BASS
-Increased damage of two-scimitar moves

cZV.text:
1.4 - Update

------------------------------------------------------------------

GAMEPLAY CHANGES/BALANCES:

-Replaced FT's Dimension with The Eternal Flames

-Replaced Dark Cave Ring with Rocket Station

-Added air hangtime for all characters

-Reworked characters:

CHIRPY:

PAPA:

JAY
-Added lightfreeze to RM stage 2

NEURAL
-Added stage 2 to AN
-Added aerial-cancel property

GEM
-Grab now spikes properly

NINJA
-Gave AN double-hit, reduced damage per hit
-Increased friction and adjusted speed

LAVENDER
-Reduced height gain from AN

STICK & BIRDII
-Added lightfreeze to AN stage 2
-Increased damage of DN from 2 to 2.4

ROUTE
-Added 8 frames of invulnerability to start of DN

ALZTER
-Added aerial-cancel property

VANNI
-Removed heavyfreeze on AN

MUSHBY
-Rebound AM (down input) to SideM.

ALEX
-Added heavyfreeze to RM stage 2
-Increased multihit frequency of RM stage 1
-Changed hitsound of RM

DYNAMIC
-Added lightfreeze to RN stage 2

-Decreased damage of RM stage 1 from 0.6 to 0.2

EREN

eyq: I wonder what would happen if you got all 10 combos in a game...

XGq: Ashleydialogue
I see you've been playin' Chirpy, haven'tcha?
I wonder if Chirpy misses Radwell now that he's off travelling the world...
If you ever meet Chirpy, tell him I said hi!
I'm such a big fan of his games! "Chirpy 4" was my favorite.
You've been fighting as Jay. I can tell because your M key looks a bit more busted than usual.
Unless you haven't been spamming his pink barrage, in which case I need new contact lenses. Hehe.
Ah, you've seen Jay?
Last I saw him he went off with Tai and Kev to revive his dead brother... Wonder how that's going...
I see you've been playing Rae recently...
I can tell because of the amount of missed pronunciations I've heard out there!
If you meet Rae on the battlefield, tell him I love his MAPs!
I honestly prefer his TFA MAP over his others.
Hmm... last played Papa, eh?
Give the m button a rest kiddo, you'll do everyone a favor. Hehe.
Papa's got so much weaponry to choose from. No wonder he's a favorite in Papa the Bear Adventures!
My favorite shooter is the cotton shooter. It's such a classic!
Ooh, you've picked up Neural I see.
I betcha your opponents never saw that second wind coming!
Pass this on next time you see Neural out there,
"Your art is amaaaaazing!!!"
You've picked up Code Kirby huh?
Despite his small stature, he's pretty tough. His discharge is especially painful!
Aww! Code is sooo cute!
His fighting style is pretty iconic too! I recognize it from KCCR, no?
Oh hey! You've been playing Chocky and Ben!
It's cool her brother joined the fight! But I do miss those pies...
Say hi to Chocky and Ben for me!
They make quite the team, don't they?
Watch out! It's an Asher player!
All his moves pack a punch, but I see that you've used his trusty hammer quite a bit.
The last time I met Asher, I was playing his game... what was it called...
Asher Head Smasher! Of course! How could I forget?
Shurikens! Explosives! Arrows! Hiya!
Sorry, you played a great Ninja. I couldn't resist. Hehe.
Man, it's been a while since I last played "The Ninja 5."
Wonder how long until we get a new game...? Maybe with a new mentor!
Ooh, ya played Lavender didn'tcha?
Don't lie. I smell the gasoline and smoke all over ya. Hehe.
You'd think Lavender would save her town by putting out the fires, no?
Ironic. Fighting fire with fire. I'd opt for a fire hose!
Playin' Gem? Nice.
Her violin's pretty gnarly. I dunno what it sounds like but from the looks of it, your opponents aren't havin' a good time!
Y'know, it's been a while since I last heard of Gem.
She kinda just left without a trace. Maybe she's still stuck on that island full of bread ends? Or maybe she's working at Joe's wafffle house...
Stick and Birdii! What a wonderful pair.
Do you prefer the gauntlet moves? Or are the Scythe swings more handy for ya?
Y'know, Stick and Birdii are a nice pair, but it's not the same without Falsestick.
But y'know, ya can't have everything in this world can ya?
Huh, Flamingtorpedo? Interesting.
She's a pretty heavy hitter, considering her size. That cyclone attack of hers is awfully frightening!
FT's stopped fighting people here, instead she's been going at it on her own game, while Fley's taken his spot in the limelight.
Not that I'm complaining, Fley's a funny guy! Just maybe a bit overwhelming, hehe.
Aha! Playin' Route today, huh?
Those bees he sends out don't look like much, but the fact that they're sure to hit their target is quite scary!
Tell Route I said hi! Here, take this hot cocoa and give it to him too.
It's in a shiny new mug too! No spillage. Perfect for FPC shenanigans.
Alzter's your guy now, aint it?
I see you've been using his counter a lot. It's great at preserving what little health he has, plus it deals a lotta damage!
If I'm gonna be honest, Alzter kinda scares me.
But then again, if he weren't scary he wouldn't be doin well at intimidating his foes. He's pretty much a godslayer after all, ha!
Ooh, ABIC. Cool pick!
Don't get too comfy playin' with regenerating health! You might get used to it and wonder why everyone feels so much weaker!
Mind telling ABIC that I said hi next time you meet him?
I'm pretty fond of his "Scratch Chronology" series. Plus, I love his buttery smooth animations!
You've been playin Tem? Nice.
That sword charge of his can come pretty handy sometimes!
Do you think Sam's gonna take over again? I hope not.
If anything happens, Tem's our hero, so we'll probably be fine!
Ooh, James. Fun!
I can hear you spamming his moves from the other side of the place! He's pretty dang loud, don'cha think?
When's the last time you saw James?
I remember seeing him with the Quatery Chosen ones. They were a pretty wacky team!
Ah, playin' Penciline eh?
I can tell because you've used Duckron's propeller drill quite a bit. It's pretty strong though! I don't blame ya for usin' it.
Tell Penciline that I loved watching her adventures fighting Max at Eraser Island!
I also quite enjoyed her time travelling experience. Tell her that too!
Playin' Vanni, arent'cha?
If you're having a hard time getting tasks done, I'd give it a rest. HP isn't everything!
Next time you cross Vanni, tell her I said hello!
I really enjoyed Friday Night Scratchin'! I hope the reboot'll be just as good!
Hmm... You've seen Mushby?
I can tell based on the amount of times you tried to pogo your opponent with your aerial attack!
Tell Mushby I'd love to hang out sometime!
He seems like a pretty fun guy. His meme projects are pretty funny too!
Hey hey! Been playin Hektor and Fancy havent'cha?
A word for the wise: Hektor's a zoner and can use Fancy as a puppet better. Fancy meanwhile is more of an upfront fighter.

You can give em some new colors, or you can give em a hat!
But the most exciting part is that you get to change their special moves!
You can select between three different M and Down M moves. Pretty flexible ain't it?
Once you're satisfied with your Canvas, you can leave the studio, and I'll save it for the next time you use them in battle.
